SQN.notes: TTM net profit: FY2025 366,392k (annual report financial-analysis page; EPS 24.49 pre-split) - H1 2025 158,204,741 + H1 2026 153,610,396 (interim report) = 361.8m. Dataset implies 5,374.4/14.68 = 366.1m (or 35.18/14.68 = 2.40 per share): within 1.2% of the document, no source-vs-document cut. ONE-OFF: Yuh remeasurement gain 61.9m (company's letter to shareholders, primary, opened); net one-off impact +49.8m (FX News Group quoting the company; Finance Magnates 16 Jan 2026 quotes 'net positive impact of about CHF 50 million') - the company's Financial Report 2025 PDF (library.swissquote.com/shared-images/9l4ztq-financial-report-2025) was blocked by the fetch tool, so the breakdown, the tax treatment and whether the other items fall in H2 2025 are NOT verified. Net one-off = 49.8/361.8 = 13.8% of TTM profit -> k about 0.862 if the offset is accepted, 0.829 if only the documented gain is used. H1 2026 contains no one-off gain; it contains a CHF 5.3m crypto inventory mark-to-market loss (H1 2025: +1.7m gain) - recurring trading item, not listed. Tax rate = H1 2026 income tax 29.27 / pre-tax 182.88 = 16.0% (H1 2025: 14.6%). Guidance is pre-tax profit (about 365m for 2026), not EPS -> not usable under the rule; for information: 365 x (1 - 0.16) = about 307m net vs TTM 361.8m = 0.85 (my arithmetic), i.e. the guidance and the one-off adjustment point to the same earnings level.
